name: Avista Grande Karon Resort & Spa Phuket - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 159-room Sino-Portuguese-styled boutique resort steps from Karon Beach, with a 4.7/5 ALL rating from over 1,100 reviews.
ai_summary: Avista Grande Karon Resort & Spa Phuket sits just steps from Karon Beach, styled around Phuket's Sino-Portuguese heritage and tin-mining history. Accor's own listing shows a 4.7/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,138 reviews, and describes 159 rooms and suites starting at 53 sqm, with mountain, pool, or sea views. Dining includes the Portosino restaurant and CHAR'D, described as a dine-on-water steakhouse, alongside the Pearl Spa.

faqs.question: Is Avista Grande Karon close to the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's steps from the white sandy beaches of Karon Beach, one of Phuket's main west-coast beach areas. The 159-room boutique resort blends Sino-Portuguese architecture inspired by Phuket's tin-mining heritage with a 4.7/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,138 reviews, one of the highest found among the island's Accor properties.
